summary_en: Interim dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 set at 48 yen per share (13 yen ordinary, 35 yen special). Company maintains policy of 70 yen annual special dividend and total shareholder returns exceeding 20 billion yen through fiscal 2028.
title_en: Notice Regarding Interim Dividend (Ordinary and Special Dividends) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
Aizawa Securities Group announced an interim dividend of 48 yen per share for fiscal year ending March 2027, comprising 13 yen in ordinary dividend and 35 yen in special dividend. The record date is September 30, 2026, with formal approval planned at a board meeting in late October 2026.

The company maintains its shareholder return policy announced on April 26, 2024. From fiscal 2025 through fiscal 2028, the company plans total shareholder returns exceeding 20 billion yen through dividends and share buybacks. Ordinary dividends target dividend payout ratio (DOE) exceeding 2 percent, while special dividends are set at 70 yen per share annually. The company aims for a consolidated payout ratio of 50 percent or higher. In fiscal 2025, the company acquired 6.16 million shares for approximately 10.78 billion yen.

For fiscal 2027, the full-year special dividend is planned at 70 yen per share. The final dividend for the fiscal year remains undetermined pending business results.
